props.name: allowClear
props.description: Show a clear button when a value is selected.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: closeIcon
props.description:
Icon used when the action button clears the selection.
Tag remove buttons keep using this icon as well.

props.name: createItem
props.description:
Factory used for unmatched free-text creation.
Providing it also enables the editable search input.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial popup state.

props.name: defaultSearchValue
props.description: Initial search text.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The default value of the input (uncontrolled).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the input is disabled.

props.name: emptyRender
props.description: Custom renderer for the empty state when current filtered result has no matches.

props.name: filterItem
props.description: Filtering strategy or predicate receiving the raw item.

props.name: gutter
props.description: Anchor gap in pixels.

props.name: id
props.description: The ID of the input element.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Optional editable inner input element ref. Not assigned in non-editable mode.

props.name: isItemDisabled
props.description: Additional disabled policy evaluated against the current selection.

props.name: itemProps
props.description: Additional row attributes.

props.name: itemRender
props.description: Custom item presentation.

props.name: items
props.description: Source items, optionally grouped. Item values must be unique within the collection.

props.name: itemToLabelString
props.description: Machine-readable text for matching; does not change visual labels.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon shown before the input/value area.

props.name: listboxProps
props.description: Additional listbox attributes.

props.name: loading
props.description: Whether the select is in a loading state.

props.name: loadingIcon
props.description: Icon shown during loading state.

props.name: maxCount
props.description: Maximum number of selected values (multiple/tags).

props.name: maxTagCount
props.description: Maximum visible tags before collapsing the remainder into a +N summary.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the input element, used for form submission.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the selection changes.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called when clear is triggered.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when popup state changes.

props.name: onReset
props.description: Post-reset notification after an unprevented native form reset.

props.name: onScrollBottom
props.description: Called once when scrolling reaches the bottom.

props.name: onSearch
props.description: Called when search text changes.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled popup state.

props.name: openOnControlClick
props.description:
Whether ordinary control/input pointer clicks open the popup.
Defaults to `false` when editable (`search` or `createItem` enabled),
or `true` when non-editable.

props.name: overflowPadding
props.description: Collision padding in pixels.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text shown when no value is selected.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the input is read-only.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the input is required.

props.name: scrollBottomThreshold
props.description: Bottom threshold in pixels.

props.name: scrollToItem
props.description: Scroll a highlighted item to its logical entry index.

props.name: search
props.description: Whether the collection can be filtered through the editable input.

props.name: searchMaxLength
props.description: Maximum committed search length.

props.name: searchValue
props.description: Controlled search text.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the component.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: tagOverflow
props.description: Custom renderer for tags hidden by `maxTagCount`.

props.name: tagRender
props.description: Custom renderer for each selected tag.

props.name: tokenSeparators
props.description:
Strings that commit completed input tokens through `createItem` or an exact source match.
Duplicate separators are ignored and overlapping separators prefer the longest match.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Icon used when the action button opens the dropdown.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value of the input (controlled).

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual treatment of the component.

props.name: virtualRender
props.description: Virtual rendering adapter.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary item description.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether this item cannot be selected.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading item icon.

props.name: label
props.description: Visual label.

props.name: value
props.description: Unique selection and form value.
